theme: A clinic visit in the city, then home to Florida.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The day stays open until an early-afternoon neurology visit with Mike at HSS, then you're wheels-up from LaGuardia tonight for Florida and the St. Petersburg stay. One thing's slipped past due: the last Dubrovnik night still needs a room.

needsAttention.title: Lock the last Dubrovnik night
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 travel task went a day past due (Aug 23). It's the single Sept 19 room in Cavtat near the airport, after the charter disembarks and before the 7:30am Sept 20 flight — the first three nights are already confirmed.
